$comment: Sample people, groups and institutions for site simulations. Style rules: STYLE.md. Photos: photos/<id>.jpg, made by scripts/cast.mjs. Every entry is fictional.
base: Square 1:1 image. The subject is centred so a small circular crop still reads. No text, no lettering, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no flags, no football club crests. Not a real or famous person.

styles.selfie: WhatsApp profile photo. Front-camera selfie of {look}. Shot on a mid-range Android phone: slight wide-angle distortion, a little noise, imperfect framing, arm-length distance, whole head inside the frame. Photorealistic, ordinary, not a model, not retouched.
styles.mirror: WhatsApp profile photo. Mirror selfie of {look}. The phone partly covers the chin, a real home mirror with small marks, normal room light. Photorealistic, ordinary, not retouched.
styles.candid: WhatsApp profile photo. Photo of {look}, taken by a friend with a phone. Natural light, a little motion blur or backlight is fine. Photorealistic, ordinary, not posed like an advert.
styles.family: WhatsApp profile photo. Phone photo of {look}. Both faces are visible and close together, warm and casual. Photorealistic, ordinary home snapshot.
styles.pet: WhatsApp profile photo. Phone photo of {look}. No people. The animal fills most of the frame. Photorealistic, ordinary snapshot.
styles.object: WhatsApp profile photo. Phone photo of {look}. No people. Photorealistic, slightly saturated, the kind of picture people pick as a profile photo.
styles.stylized: WhatsApp profile photo. {look}. Clean background in one soft colour, head and shoulders, friendly. Original character, not a copy of any film studio, brand or app style.
styles.stock: WhatsApp profile photo. Polished stock-style headshot of {look}. Studio light, very smooth skin, neutral grey background, a little too perfect, like a photo taken from an image bank.
styles.group: WhatsApp group photo. Phone photo of {look}. Faces small but visible, everyone close together, real people of mixed ages and skin tones. Photorealistic, ordinary snapshot.
styles.logo: Profile picture for a small fictional Brazilian business: {look}. Flat vector mark, one or two colours, centred on a plain background, no letters, no words.
